terrain.required_source: A DEM, DSM or DTM pixel-aligned to every source JPG; RGB and multispectral reflectance are not elevation substitutes.

feature_policy.reason: Absolute elevation can leak flight/site identity. Relative shape factors are safer candidates.
feature_policy.promotion_rule: Promote only paired train/valid gains that remain stable across at least three grouped seeds.
feature_policy.test_policy: Do not generate or evaluate test terrain features until one final candidate is frozen.
